ns2:section.sectionText: Class has a service-learning component. Student will arrange 2 additional hours weekly of service learning time outside of the classroom to be coordinated with the instructor. All seats restricted during the early registration period. This restriction will be lifted on November 30, 2011 by 9:00 a.m. Students must meet the prerequisite requirements for this course (found in the Catalog Entry) or will be told to drop on the first day of classes. Non-registered students are not allowed to sit in or audit.
